guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice has the largest latency shift (p90 0.0044s to 0.2109s, z=+944) and is the common callee of the other slow services (recommendationservice, checkoutservice, frontend), while its workload dropped, so the cause is not load. There are no errors or warnings in the logs and no error spans in the traces, which fits a pure delay fault, though CPU or memory pressure on productcatalogservice cannot be fully ruled out because no resource metrics appear in the top series.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect productcatalogservice pods for network delay or resource contention (tc/netem rules, CPU throttling, node-level issues). Then restart or reschedule the affected pod to a healthy node and watch latency recover.
